competitors.name: Beyond Meat / Kroger
competitors.action: Beyond Meat rolled out Beyond Chicken Pieces Spicy Buffalo to more than 2,000 Kroger stores nationwide, extending the brand's frozen retail footprint with a convenience-first, high-protein, clean-label product aimed at mainstream grocery shoppers.

competitors.name: Amy's Kitchen
competitors.action: Amy's Kitchen promoted longtime insider Paul Schiefer to CEO as founder Andy Berliner moved to executive chairman, signaling that a major premium frozen-food player is entering its next growth phase with an explicit focus on innovation, sustainability, and operational discipline.

competitors.name: Conagra / Frozen Category
competitors.action: Conagra's Future of Frozen Food 2026 report highlighted multi-serve meals, pizzas, and frozen sides as roughly a $12B shared-meal segment, with value-size products now over 40% of frozen aisle sales, reinforcing that freezer growth is being driven by family-style value and restaurant-style convenience rather than niche premium alone.

trends.topic: Frozen growth is clustering around mainstream convenience plus family-value, while premium brands are tightening leadership and portfolio strategy to keep up
trends.magnitude: Beyond expanded frozen protein distribution at Kroger, Amy's formalized a succession move around innovation and operational growth, and Conagra framed pizzas and multi-serve frozen meals as a $12B shared-meal lane with value-size products above 40% of aisle sales
trends.context: The category signal today is not just premiumization. The freezer is rewarding products that are easy, shareable, and retailer-ready at scale. Real Dough should keep its artisan story, but the offer has to travel with strong convenience and value logic if it wants mass retail relevance.

market_data.value: ~$12B across multi-serve meals, pizzas, and frozen sides

market_data.metric: Value-size frozen share of aisle sales

breaking.headline: The freezer aisle is rewarding brands that pair strong product identity with retailer-scale convenience and value
breaking.impact: For Real Dough, the takeaway is to avoid a vague premium pitch. The winning retail story likely needs three things together: a clear product hook, dead-simple at-home usage, and a family-value frame that can stand up in a Kroger-style aisle.
